The main difference is the goal: hypertrophy focuses on maximizing muscle size, while strength training focuses on maximizing the amount of force your muscles can produce. 

For hypertrophy, you typically train in the 6–12 rep range with moderate weights (around 65–85% of your 1RM) and shorter rest periods to create mechanical tension and metabolic stress.
